--- title: data.fetch_data.fetch_holiday_data --- ```python data.fetch_data.fetch_holiday_data( start, end, tz='UTC', freq='h', country_code='DE', state='NW', ) ``` Fetches holiday data for the dataset period. ## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters} | Name | Type | Description | Default | |--------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------|------------| | start | [str](`str`) or [pd](`pandas`).[Timestamp](`pandas.Timestamp`) | Start date of the dataset period. | _required_ | | end | [str](`str`) or [pd](`pandas`).[Timestamp](`pandas.Timestamp`) | End date of the dataset period. | _required_ | | tz | [str](`str`) | Timezone for the holiday data. | `'UTC'` | | freq | [str](`str`) | Frequency of the holiday data. | `'h'` | | country_code | [str](`str`) | Country code for the holidays. | `'DE'` | | state | [str](`str`) | State code for the holidays. | `'NW'` | ## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns} | Name | Type | Description | |--------|------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------| | | [pd](`pandas`).[DataFrame](`pandas.DataFrame`) | pd.DataFrame: DataFrame containing holiday information. | ## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples} ::: {#d163d37f .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from spotforecast2_safe.data.fetch_data import fetch_holiday_data holiday_df = fetch_holiday_data( start='2023-01-01T00:00', end='2023-01-10T00:00', tz='UTC', freq='h', country_code='DE', state='NW' ) holiday_df.head() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ```{=html}
